subject: 3,000 fans crushed the IQ Quiz today
preview_text: See how your football knowledge stacks up against the crowd. The leaderboard just dropped.
body_paragraphs: While you were deciding whether to open this, 3,000 other fans just finished the IQ Quiz. Half of them scored over 80%. The other half? Let's just say their egos took a hit. And one guy from Manchester literally screamed at his phone because he got a question wrong about his own club.

Here's the thing — every single one of those fans now knows exactly where they stand. They've got a leaderboard rank, a badge for their streak, and bragging rights in their community. Meanwhile, your football IQ is sitting there untested. Data doesn't lie, and right now your data says 'inactive.'

The IQ Quiz isn't some random trivia. It's built from real match data — xG, defensive stats, head-to-head history. The AI adjusts the difficulty based on your answers, so it's actually hard. And when you finish, you can compare your score with fans in your league. The top 100 get a shoutout in the community feed tomorrow.
Open Predictify now, tap the IQ Quiz icon, and prove you're not just guessing. P.S. — the guy who screamed? He's now second in his community. Don't let that be you.
